description: Named cases for contrastive prompt evaluation (scripts/compare_prompts.py, D036). The ids and strata are reusable for any candidate; 'expected' is the verdict the Product-article rule of prompt v1.11.0 gives the named brand, chosen by reading the article, and is re-read if that rule changes. Gray-zone cases carry none and are reported, not scored. A case whose article is the source of a quoted prompt example names the quote ('prompt_example') and is kept out of accuracy; the harness also flags any other title that matches a quote in the candidate prompt. From #219 (v1.12.0, D037): 'financial' cases (substantive stock, earnings or analyst coverage expected true, a market wrap that only names the brand expected false) and 'no_category' cases (#118's human corrections) should get no ESG category on any brand; the report lists any category kept on them, and on Product cases. 'financial_gray' cases are scored on the verdict and their categories read by hand. A case may also rule the brand's categories ('expected.categories', the applicable ones; the 'partial_categories' case does), and the report checks every reply against them. #118's Mammut rope review was already a product_true case.
